Admonition.definition: A callout box that sets a note, tip, or warning apart from the surrounding text.

Astro Integration.definition: A package that hooks into the Astro build to add pages, transform content, or change configuration.

Glossary Term.definition: A term written as `[[term]]` in MDX that links to its page and shows its definition in a tooltip.

llms.txt.definition: A plain-text index of a site's pages, written for language models and agents.

MDX.definition: Markdown that can import and render components.

Mermaid.definition: A text syntax for diagrams, such as flowcharts and sequence diagrams.

Open Graph.definition: Meta tags that tell social platforms and chat apps which title, description, and image to show in a link preview.

Sätteri.definition: A markdown processor for Astro, written in Rust, that runs plugins over the syntax tree.
